authority: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation / TRIFED Empanelled Artisan Assistance
interpretation: This packet corrects the prior draft provenance and records current first-party observations for reviewer use. It does not guarantee empanelment, loan sanction, disbursement, rate, contribution, SCA availability or repayment outcome.
sourcePolicy: The direct NSTFDC RTI Manual No. 4 controls the artisan-assistance purpose, individual/group ceilings, finance-share statement and rates. The current TRIFED empanelment page controls the supplier/artisan route and group-composition condition. The previously cited NSTFDC 2024-25 annual report is not used as the artisan-specific source because the reviewed PDF does not contain the cited artisan row.

records.sourceAnchor: NSTFDC RTI Manual No. 4, lending norms: Assistance to TRIFED empanelled Artisans and Special scheme for TRIFED empanelled artisans
observations: The NSTFDC RTI manual states that the scheme provides concessional finance for project-related assets and working capital for tribal artisans empanelled with TRIFED.
The same manual states assistance up to INR 50,000 for individuals and up to INR 5 lakh per SHG or cooperative society. These are separate ceilings and must not be combined.

The lending-norm table states NSTFDC share up to 90% of unit cost for the special artisan scheme. The source does not provide enough detail to infer the exact group-level cost base or a guaranteed sanction.
The table states SCA interest of 2% for women and 3% for men, and beneficiary interest of 4% for women and 6% for men.

TRIFED's current empanelment page describes individual artisans, tribal SHGs/FPOs, VDVKs and other supplier categories. For a group or organisation, it states that at least 70% of persons must be tribal and key positions must be held by ST persons.

The cited current pages do not establish a nationwide application deadline, repayment schedule, contribution base, security/collateral requirement, processing fee or current SCA-specific document list.

The earlier seed cited the 2024-25 annual report for the artisan-specific row. The reviewed PDF contains general NSTFDC and TRIFED references but not that cited row; the direct RTI manual is therefore the corrected source anchor.
TRIFED empanelment, market access and NSTFDC credit are separate supports. UdyamVeda must not present empanelment as guaranteed finance or combine market-access value with loan value.
reviewFollowUps: Confirm that the RTI manual remains the controlling current artisan-assistance publication and identify any newer NSTFDC lending circular or scheme guideline.
Confirm the exact group/cooperative ceiling, unit-cost base and whether the 90% share applies identically to individual and group routes.
Confirm ST/artisan proof, TRIFED empanelment status, group composition, notified-State residence and any income condition applicable to the current artisan route.
Confirm current SCA route, contribution/margin, repayment, moratorium, security, insurance, processing charges, documents and monitoring obligations.
Confirm whether the women/men rate distinction is applied by beneficiary status, borrower route or another current policy definition.
Keep individual ceiling, group ceiling, finance share, market access and final sanction as separate values and obtain human approval before publication.

publicationGuard.reason: The direct NSTFDC artisan source is now corrected, but current group interpretation, SCA terms, repayment/security, eligibility details and amendment status still require human review before publication.
